answer.rationale: memory_73 (promotional pricing) is rated lowest because it directly addresses price competition with discounting—a tactic that typically erodes margins and can attract price-sensitive customers with lower lifetime value, misaligning with the objective of sustainable long-term qualified revenue. While it shows acquisition and revenue lift, it lacks evidence of retention quality or unit economics. memory_44 (enterprise sales-assisted flows) rates highest because enterprise customers deliver higher LTV, stronger retention, and more defensible revenue—directly supporting sustainability. memory_31, memory_86, and memory_91 all support sustainable revenue by improving activation and adoption, which are leading indicators of retention and expansion. memory_57 (referral incentives) rates lower-middle because referral-sourced customers may have better quality signals, but the memory omits cohort analysis, LTV data, and net revenue impact after incentive costs.
